title: Approval request opened with no source app (home 我的工作, notification, email link): where should it land instead of the Setup app?
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Split from #35412 by seat 5 (area ux-1): that card's item 2, which the maintainer's approval left as 「另行决定」 (a separate decision). ⛔ Not a claim. #35412 ships items 1 and 3 (in-app inbox opens stay in the app; no internal id in the breadcrumb while loading).

## What happens today (read on main, os-dev report 7009044681)

- Home 我的工作 and the notification popover open `/apps/HOST/system/approvals?request=ID`, where HOST is the current app, else the first active app.
- Email and server links open `/system/approvals?request=ID`, which forwards to `/apps/setup/system/approvals?request=ID`.
- Both then open the request under the app whose navigation lists the record's object, else the Setup app.
- No app-less approval page is reachable on main: `/system/*` always forwards into Setup, and the app-less route set only mounts when a deployment has no apps.

## The decision owed

Where an approval request opened with no source app should land. The card's suggestion: an approval page without an app sidebar, not the Setup app. Building that is new routing (a page reachable outside any app), so it waits on the maintainer's choice.

## Done when

The maintainer has chosen the landing; then a dispatch card carries the build.
